T: Huggies, and whatever cash you got.
D: An ex-con and an ex-cop who can't have a baby take one of furniture king Nathan Arizona's quintuplets, and everyone in Arizona comes after him.
P: Fire up the chimichangas when Hi robs the store for Huggies.
S: Crawfish boiled with corn, potatoes and spice. No fowl? Then we ate crawdad.

Bring a big pot of water to the boil with the seasoning, half a lemon and the garlic. Boil the potatoes until nearly tender, then add the corn for 5 minutes. Add the yabbies just to heat through, then drain. Melt the butter with the remaining lemon juice and parsley, pour over and tip it all out on the table.
1kg cooked yabbies or crawfish, in the shell@Seafood
Cheddar, cream cheese and jalapeño balls. Funny shapes? Not unless round is funny.
Mix the cream cheese, cheddar and jalapenos and roll into 20 balls, then chill until firm. Roll in flour, then egg, then panko. Fry at 180C in batches until golden. Drain and serve with ranch.
M: Spiced beef wrapped in tortillas and fried crisp. Nathan Arizona was born Huffhines.

Brown the beef in a heavy pot, add the onion, garlic, spices and tomatoes and a cup of water. Cover and simmer gently until the beef falls apart, then shred it in the sauce. Spoon beef and cheese onto each tortilla, fold in the sides and roll up tight. Shallow-fry seam side down first, turning, until crisp and golden. Serve with salsa and sour cream.
Chilli lime chicken charred black on the grill. He left a scorched earth in his wake.

Mix the chilli, juice of a lime, garlic, oil and salt and coat the chicken. Grill the corn over high heat, turning, until charred all over. Grill the chicken over high heat until blackened in spots and cooked through, then rest. Brush the corn with mayo, roll in feta and dust with chilli. Slice the chicken, scatter with coriander and serve with the corn and lime wedges.
W: Fluffy doughnuts rolled in cinnamon sugar. Want a Dunkin' Donuts? Call a cop.

Mix the flour, yeast, 50g sugar, milk, egg and butter into a soft dough and knead until smooth. Cover and leave until doubled. Roll out 1.5cm thick, cut rings and leave to puff for 20 minutes. Fry at 175C, a minute or so a side, until golden. Toss in the cinnamon sugar and serve with warmed dulce de leche.
K: Prickly pear and lime margarita with a salt rim, from Hi and Ed's trailer in the desert.
Rub the glass rims with lime and dip in salt. Shake the tequila, liqueur, syrup and lime juice hard with ice. Strain over fresh ice.
